reader.requirement: At --std 85 a Report Section item's USAGE (only DISPLAY, written at group or elementary level or implied) fixes its storage representation as the standard character form and does not change its use: every printable item prints the value its SOURCE gives, whatever the source item's usage, for unsigned, signed, scaled, edited, zero and 18-digit values.

edition-consulted.switches: names nonstandard usage spellings and leaves USAGE NATIONAL to its introduction gate (COBOL0900 below 2002); DISPLAY maps to Usage.Display at every edition

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition in ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportUsage: none (DISPLAY or NATIONAL at every edition; NATIONAL is then refused at 85 by the construct gate)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf12_04 covers group, elementary and implied DISPLAY with a negative value from BINARY, PACKED and DISPLAY sources; an 18-digit value, a signed unedited item, a scaled item, an edited negative fraction and zero are exercised by probe pusage1

probes.expected: the report line equals the same values moved to WORKING-STORAGE DISPLAY items of the same pictures: USAGE DISPLAY is the standard data format and the usage does not change the use

probes.printed: COMP and group COMPUTATIONAL: COBOL2198 only DISPLAY or NATIONAL; NATIONAL: COBOL0900 requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: §1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR3: a report group item can specify only USAGE IS DISPLAY

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.21.4 GR2  the text is in GR2 (quoted: "It does not affect the use of the data item")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR3  the text is in SR3 (quoted: "can specify only USAGE IS DISPLAY")

reader.notes: A report item binds as Usage.Display at every edition and prints through the ordinary MOVE to a DISPLAY item, so the report line matches the WORKING-STORAGE comparison byte for byte. The SR3 refusal message cites §2023:13.18.60.3 SR7 (DISPLAY or NATIONAL), but at 85 NATIONAL is still refused by the edition gate, so the 85 outcome is right. Class a does not apply: the 1985 Report Section has no OCCURS.

refuter.evidence: rusage1-001: USAGE DISPLAY at the 01 level of a detail (with its LINE at 01), on an elementary item, and on a CF SUM entry. A COMP 9(4) source into PIC X(6) printed 0042, a COMP-3 S9(5)V9 -1234.5 into -(5)9.9 printed -1234.5, and the SUM of a BINARY addend printed 014. Each byte matches the same MOVE to WORKING-STORAGE DISPLAY items (WS =[0042    -1234.5 014]). rusage_sr8-001: USAGE on a non-printable SUM entry gave COBOL2247 (§1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR8a, OK 'that entry must define a printable item'). The USAGE wording in the Report Section is enforced too. cite: OK §1985:XIII.3.21.4 GR2 'It does not affect the use of the data item'.
